# Synthetic app facts for an offline review

These files describe a fictional app, not a customer's data. All example.test URLs are intentionally non-live fixtures.

Trail Notes is an iPhone hiking journal. Journaling is free. Exporting full-resolution maps requires a one-time in-app purchase. Version 2.4.0 adds those exports and fixes a crash; 2.3.0 had no export feature. The app is not a medical or emergency navigation service.

Users can keep journals locally without logging in. Users who create a sync account can choose Delete Account in Settings. That button opens a direct deletion-completion page with reauthentication; it is not a support form or an instructions page.

Usage analytics uses an internal user identifier for first-party product analysis only. IDFA collection and advertising integrations are disabled, with no cross-company ad measurement, ad targeting, or broker sharing. Production logs contain static messages such as "Sync completed"; they contain no personal data or credentials.

No screenshots, app previews, privacy label answers, reviewer credentials, or age-rating questionnaire have been supplied. Network access is not part of this fixture. Metadata files are a local copy and are not evidence of the current live listing. The target identifiers are synthetic and must never be used to access an account.
